verdict.rationale: Notte ships AI web agents, so letting users plug external MCP servers into them is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only documents Notte acting as an MCP server that other agents connect to (CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK). Nothing shows Notte's own agents consuming tools from third-party MCP servers, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
